notes:
Scope: read-only static audit. Nothing edited, no git writes, no servers. The 16 target machine files are not in the git status modified list, so they reflect HEAD; streaks.ts and buffs were read as currently modified in the working tree. Timings and behaviour come from code only, not from a running build, so the feel itself is unverified.

Engine verdict: the shared juice engine is solid (TIER_SHOW juice.ts:84-93, tiered celebrate and escalate juice.ts:150-254, winFeel curve tiers.ts:119-146, AttractScript juice.ts:411, nearMiss, pourCoins, countUp). Most gaps are in how machines call it, not in the engine.

Cross-cutting findings:
(a) celebrate is called without bet or mult in 15 of 16 callers; only mahjong passes bet (mahjong/index.ts:536). winFeel therefore uses tier floors.
(b) The adaptive music is never driven by machine play. setIntensity and setState callers are only cutscene/effects.ts:43-44 and horror/director.ts:121-125.
(c) Unused existing parts: tensionRise riser (sfx.ts:883, only bigone), reelLoop (only bandit and bigone), Voice.setPitch (zero callers in src/machines), nearMissLine (reels.ts:158, zero callers), fx.trail (only coinflip), comboTwinkle (no machine listens).
(d) juice.celebrate and juice.nearMiss ignore flashPrefs (juice.ts:48; only bigone reads it). Any new flash or zoom should check calm and reduced first.
(e) juice.ts:15 says never await a long show inside present(); elevator/index.ts:414 does.
